stages.name: Foundation
stages.work: Glute bridge → straight-leg bridge; thoracic extension over a roller; overhead reach against a wall, ribs down; wrist prep
ready: arms overhead flat to the wall

exercises.name: Wrist extension rocks
exercises.cue: Kneeling, palms down, rock forward and back.

exercises.name: Thoracic extension over a roller
exercises.cue: Roller at mid-back, hands behind the head, extend over it with the ribs down.

exercises.name: Overhead reach against a wall
exercises.cue: Back to the wall, ribs down, arms overhead pressed flat to the wall. Stop where the back starts to arch.

exercises.name: Straight-leg bridge
exercises.cue: Hips high, glutes tight, ribs down. Bend the knees (glute bridge) if the straight-leg version cramps.

stages.name: Hands high
stages.work: Bridge with hands on a high bench, lowering the surface over time

exercises.name: Wrist extension rocks
exercises.cue: Kneeling, palms down, fingers pointing back toward the knees, rock gently back and forth.

exercises.name: Overhead reach against a wall
exercises.cue: Back to the wall, ribs down, arms overhead pressed flat to the wall. Stop where the back starts to arch.

exercises.name: Kneeling chest opener on a bench
exercises.cue: Kneel, hands on the bench, sink the chest toward the floor with the ribs down and the arms straight.

exercises.name: Bridge with hands on a bench
exercises.cue: Back to the bench, hands on its edge with the fingers toward your feet, press the hips up and let the head drop back between the arms.
exercises.note: Push the bench against a wall so it cannot slide. Start on the highest surface that feels easy (a sturdy table works), then move to a bench or chair seat, about 40 cm, as 8 reps get comfortable. Stop if the lower back pinches.

stages.name: Hands low
stages.work: Bridge from a low platform (20 → 10 cm)

exercises.name: Wrist extension rocks
exercises.cue: Kneeling, palms down, fingers pointing back toward the knees, rock gently back and forth.

exercises.name: Overhead reach against a wall
exercises.cue: Back to the wall, ribs down, arms overhead pressed flat to the wall. Stop where the back starts to arch.

exercises.name: Kneeling chest opener on a bench
exercises.cue: Kneel, hands on the bench, sink the chest toward the floor with the ribs down and the arms straight.

exercises.name: Bridge with hands on a low step
exercises.cue: Lie back with the step above your head, hands on it with the fingers toward your feet, press up until the arms are straight.
exercises.note: Start at about 20 cm and drop toward 10 cm as 8 reps get easy. Take out a book or a layer of the platform rather than rushing. Stop if the lower back pinches.

stages.name: Full bridge, floor
stages.work: Press up from lying to a full bridge, controlled
ready: 3 × 8 and one 30 s hold, arms and legs straight

exercises.name: Wrist extension rocks
exercises.cue: Kneeling, palms down, fingers pointing back toward the knees, rock gently back and forth.

exercises.name: Overhead reach against a wall
exercises.cue: Back to the wall, ribs down, arms overhead pressed flat to the wall. Stop where the back starts to arch.

exercises.name: Full bridge press-up
exercises.cue: Lie back, hands by the ears, press up through the hands and feet, push the chest toward the wall behind you.
exercises.note: Straighten the arms and legs only as far as the lower back stays comfortable. Lower with control, do not drop.

exercises.name: Full bridge hold
exercises.cue: Arms and legs straight, head relaxed between the arms, breathe slowly.
exercises.note: Add a few seconds each session until one hold reaches 30 s.

stages.name: Wall walk-down
stages.work: Stand near a wall, walk the hands down into a bridge and back up

exercises.name: Wrist extension rocks
exercises.cue: Kneeling, palms down, fingers pointing back toward the knees, rock gently back and forth.

exercises.name: Overhead reach against a wall
exercises.cue: Back to the wall, ribs down, arms overhead pressed flat to the wall. Stop where the back starts to arch.

exercises.name: Full bridge press-up
exercises.cue: Warm-up for the wall work: press up from the floor, arms and legs straight.

exercises.name: Wall walk-down
exercises.cue: Back to the wall, reach back, walk the hands down the wall into a bridge, then walk back up.
exercises.note: Use a mat and clear the floor around you. Stand closer to the wall first, then step further out as it gets easy. If the hands slap or you collapse, go back one step closer. Stop if you feel dizzy.

stages.name: Closing the bridge
stages.work: From a full bridge, walk the hands toward the feet, shoulders over hands

exercises.name: Wrist extension rocks
exercises.cue: Kneeling, palms down, fingers pointing back toward the knees, rock gently back and forth.

exercises.name: Overhead reach against a wall
exercises.cue: Back to the wall, ribs down, arms overhead pressed flat to the wall. Stop where the back starts to arch.

exercises.name: Wall walk-down
exercises.cue: Warm-up: walk the hands down the wall into the bridge and back up, smooth.

exercises.name: Bridge hand walk-in
exercises.tempo: Small steps, 2 s at the closest point
exercises.cue: From a full bridge, walk the hands toward the feet a few centimetres at a time, shoulders over the hands, then walk back out.
exercises.note: Measure the gap from fingertips to heels now and then. Close it a hand-width at a time only when the last gap feels easy. Stop if the lower back pinches.

stages.name: Stand-to-stand
stages.work: Stand → bridge → stand, with a wall assist first, then free
ready: 3 consecutive free reps, no momentum drop

exercises.name: Wrist extension rocks
exercises.cue: Kneeling, palms down, fingers pointing back toward the knees, rock gently back and forth.

exercises.name: Overhead reach against a wall
exercises.cue: Back to the wall, ribs down, arms overhead pressed flat to the wall. Stop where the back starts to arch.

exercises.name: Wall-assisted stand-to-stand bridge
exercises.cue: Stand a short step from the wall, lean back, lower into the bridge with the hands near the wall, and stand up pushing lightly off it.
exercises.note: Use a mat and keep the space behind you clear. Do these only after the wall walk-down and the bridge walk-in feel easy. Use less wall each week.

exercises.name: Free stand-to-stand bridge
exercises.cue: Stand, reach back, lower to a full bridge, push the hips up, then stand back up in one smooth line without rocking.
exercises.note: This is the test. Build toward 3 clean reps in a row. Stop if the back is sore, the wrists are tired, or you feel dizzy, and rest longer between attempts if you need to.
